title: Dual Risk Quantification: Measuring the Interaction Effect of Oversight Failure and Capability

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Whether risk is superadditive with capability under oversight failure is a foundational question. If confirmed, it directly implies that safety investments must outpace capability improvements. This is among the highest-leverage findings possible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training multiple model sizes under a shared oversight failure condition and measuring harm potential across all. Multiple training runs with adversarial task evaluation is engineering-heavy and time-consuming for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple model sizes, each requiring training and evaluation, makes this a multi-experiment project. Even with 3 sizes, 30 hours is tight. The scope inherently requires comparison across conditions.
